cards.mood: The piece opens with a solemn, narrative gravity that gradually accumulates tension through swelling orchestration.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male) possesses a resonant, operatic tenor timbre with a clear, projecting quality capable of sustained high notes.
cards.palette: A grand piano and a lush string section (violins, violas, cellos) form the harmonic backbone throughout, shifting from sparse arpeggios in the intro to sweeping, legato chords in the climax.
